name: Surface NeRF
definition: A method to convert a pre-trained Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) into a 3D mesh and a surface light field, reducing per-pixel rendering cost by evaluating the NeRF only at the surface isosurface rather than via volumetric raycasting.
summary: Surface NeRF converts a pre-trained NeRF into a 3D mesh and surface light field, reducing per-pixel rendering cost by evaluating the network only at the surface isosurface rather than via volumetric raycasting.
